                    ### Question

                    ### Options
                    opa. Meconium ileus
opb. Hirschsprung disease
opc. Imperforate anus
opd. Colonic atresia
ope. Meconium plug syndrome

Hirschsprung disease and other options are less likely based on the clinical presentation.
